import math

hex_radius = 40.0
plate_thickness = 5.0
boss_radius = 10.0
boss_height = 10.0
hole_diameter = 4.5
hole_circle_radius = 20.0
chamfer_size = 0.5

        RegularPolygon(hex_radius, 6)
